item.title: Starbase takes policing into its own hands with new department
item.description: STARBASE, Texas (ValleyCentral) — The Starbase City Commission approved an ordinance to establish the city’s own police department, a move city leaders said is necessary as the community continues to grow and remains geographically isolated. item.description: HIDALGO, Texas (ValleyCentral) — BorderFest released its 2026 music lineup on Wednesday. The event will take place from March 12 to March 15 at the Payne Area in Hidalgo.
